author: Tan
html: Really enjoyed this article — thanks for sharing your insights! One part that gave me pause was Java Stream Debugging. In my experience, IntelliJ already supported stream debugging, so, I think Stream API is still better traditional for loop. I’d love to hear your thoughts!

author: Jonathan Vila
html:
Thanks for your comment Tan 🙂
I totally agree with you that Streams can be a better solution compared to loops. But as everything is not a silver bullet in my opinion. In some cases it’s easier (and more performant) a simple loop, and in others like this one where we have logic inside a stream (peek), could make more sense to use loops. That’s true that IntelliJ supports debugging inside Streams, but this example is a general and broader one.
Thanks for your thoughts on this 🙂
